name: War In Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals a cosmic conflict known as the war in heaven, where Michael the archangel and his angels engage in battle against the dragon and his angels, symbolizing the spiritual struggle against the forces of darkness (Revelation 12:7). This conflict involves principalities and powers opposed to God's people, emphasizing the spiritual nature of our warfare (Ephesians 6:12). The fall of Lucifer, the morning star, from heaven illustrates the origin of this rebellion (Isaiah 14:12), while Michael's role as protector and advocate for God's people is affirmed in Daniel 12:1 and Jude 1:9. These passages underscore the reality of spiritual warfare and the ultimate authority of the Lord in rebuking evil.
